# Federico Pomponii

> Federico Pomponii is a Senior Full-Stack AI Engineer with 10 years of experience building AI-native products and distributed systems end to end, from React interfaces to backend services, LLM systems and AWS infrastructure.

Canonical website: https://fpomponii.it
Preferred profile URL: https://fpomponii.it/
Language: English
Location: Rome, Italy
Last updated: 2026-10-07

## Professional focus

Federico ships full-stack products from problem discovery and system design to React/Next.js interfaces, TypeScript/Node.js services, PostgreSQL data layers, background processing and AWS production operations. He has worked across SaaS, media streaming, fintech, crypto, healthcare and public-sector environments.

His production AI work covers provider-agnostic agent runtimes with tool calling, risk-tiered tool permissions where state-changing actions run only after explicit user confirmation, multi-agent pipelines with cited web evidence, model routing, evaluation harnesses that compare models on behavior and cost, LLM tracing, and GDPR-compliant handling of sensitive data, including pseudonymization before LLM calls.

## How he works

Federico is strongest when a problem is ambiguous, crosses product and engineering boundaries, or needs a coherent system rather than an isolated feature. He builds context, maps constraints, defines system boundaries, chooses the architecture and stays accountable through implementation, deployment and operation.

He evaluates AI patterns on product value and operational fitness, not novelty. Reliability, security, performance, observability and cost are design inputs from the start.

## Core technologies

- TypeScript, JavaScript, React and Next.js
- Node.js, Fastify, REST, GraphQL and distributed systems
- Python for AI workflows
- AI agents, tool calling, multi-agent pipelines, structured outputs, LLM evaluation, model routing and MCP
- PostgreSQL, Prisma and event-driven architecture
- AWS (Lambda, ECS/Fargate, RDS, DynamoDB, CDK), Docker, CI/CD and observability
